meta.ocr_check: score = how much of `text` (first 300 chars) the OCR confirms (1.0 = all). note = real differences between the verified text and the OCR (single-letter noise such as I/l is ignored); highlight_scores = OCR match score per highlight phrase; line_px_at_800 = median highlight line height at 800 px width.
